          | What this is:  The browser reports violations of the logon page's Content-Security-Policy by POST (application/csp-report) to the report-uri named in the header; NetScaler logs the report as an AAA message. The report fields (document-uri, blocked-uri) come from the client and are freely writable; here they carry an OS command injection payload (echo <marker>$()\ <marker>\nz^xyu||a, three times for ', " and no quoting), the standard pattern of Burp Scanner and Nuclei. NetScaler only logged the report; the marker would appear in a response only on success.
